scope: Every changed file in the complete frozen local Git inventory, including root applications, all packages, deletions and renames. This is source applicability, not a claim that every contract is implemented or validated.

statusMeaning.implementation-pending-validation: Assigned applicable source work; implementation and integrated runtime acceptance remain with the owning work package and root.
statusMeaning.no-op: No direct native runtime port for the explicit reason; related runtime contracts remain separately in scope.
statusMeaning.tested: Current-source local full-suite and required-case evidence accepted; no broader parity or publication claim.
statusMeaning.tested-with-limitations: Current-source local full-suite evidence accepted with the recorded skips, deferrals or platform limitations; not an unqualified pass.

reviewedCategories.typescript-only: Type-level, cast or barrel-export change with no emitted runtime behavior; the native public surface is the owning package's.
reviewedCategories.node-runtime-only: Behavior specific to the Node runtime or a JavaScript SDK, with no native counterpart.
reviewedCategories.no-native-delta: A comment, a removed piece or a refactor with no behavior change: nothing native to update.
reviewedCategories.version-only: Package version and sibling dependency versions only; the native version is Directory.Build.props VersionPrefix.

review.meaning: What the work package reports state about a row: a finding, the packages that changed the file, deferred parts and notes. It is read from the reports, not from a test run, and changes no status.

meta.area: source lock, file inventory, applicability table, version pins, Node runtime pins, virtual modules, decision record

ai-catalog.area: exact 1.6.0 model catalog, default models, Qwen Token Plan providers and key variables

ai-providers.area: provider wire behavior, retries, strict-mode fallbacks, session resources

core-small.area: agent abort results, env listing and daemon output, MCP server summary

cli-tools.area: find, read, grep, bash output, exec exit codes, HTML export

cli-session.area: session runtime, modes, diagnostics, packages, extensions, llama.cpp and MCP extensions

durable-core.area: Durable harness: signals, parks, gates, hook tasks, record versions

durable-edge.area: code-mode namespaces, image fitting, durable tools, env listing, examples, hosts built on Durable

chord-foundation.area: Chord contracts, data, wire messages and codecs, channel fences, framed sources, telemetry schema rows

chord-edge.area: Chord HTTP links, app kit sign-ins, plugins, surfaces, client and connection loop, sync, telemetry ingest admission

chord-store.area: Chord store: column sets, exists and joins, read plans, the read index and skips, open and live queries, settled and onCommitted

chord-remote.area: Chord remote layer: call windows by trust, events end to end, opened(incarnation), shared holds

chord-queries.area: Chord named queries, query readers, read declarations, lists, tiling and the reusable park step

chord-admission.area: Chord admission, route admission and the denied paths on both sides of a link

chord-workers.area: Chord worker exit, store and incarnation, worker admission, TerminalScope.On
